Q2) What is the first-line treatment of anaphylaxis?

A. Oral antihistamine

B. Nebulised salbutamol

C. Intramuscular adrenaline

Explanation: The correct answer is C because adrenaline reverses shock.

Q5) Which drug closes a patent ductus arteriosus?

A. Ibuprofen

B. Prostaglandin E1

Answer: A

Answers

1. B   2. A   4. A, C
